purpose: Machine-readable home for the one state that decides whether the online surface or a research measurement is open. The two are mutually exclusive; the transition graph is total and fail-closed. Rules live in the experiment contract §20.10; enforcement lives in tests/contract/test_research_lock.py; this file carries only the state.
why_a_sidecar: The same reason `runtime_coordinate_bindings_v1` is a sidecar: nothing in this repository should parse Markdown to reach a fail-closed verdict. It is also why this file is JSON under `contracts/` rather than prose — the decision layer carries rules and state, never narrative (doc structure contract C0.1 / L3).
why_it_is_outside_every_axis_it_freezes: H0 re-entry #3 died because its declaration was simultaneously a frozen runtime-bound input and the target of the seal that mutated it, so the transition judged itself a provenance mismatch. This file classifies as `non_execution` and appears in no coordinate axis; opening and closing an instance therefore cannot move anything the instance freezes.

enforcement.ONLINE_OPEN: no freeze; the online surface is editable
enforcement.RESEARCH_OPEN: every axis in `instance.frozen_axes` must equal `instance.frozen.coordinate`, both recomputed from source and as published in docs/reference/runtime_identity.generated.json. A republish is an online move and is refused the same way.
enforcement.RESEARCH_CLOSED: no freeze is enforced. `close` is the step that lifts it: `sealed` is refused unless the freeze still holds at close time, and `voided` has abandoned the instance so the surface can move. `instance.frozen` is retained as the sealed version binding of a finished study.

what_release_does: It governs instance lifetime, not editability. It drops the instance and is the acknowledgement required before the next one can be opened, because `open` runs only from ONLINE_OPEN. Only RESEARCH_OPEN holds the online surface shut.
what_open_requires: Only that the publication is itself current against source. Whether previously accepted bindings are still admissible is a consumer question and is deliberately not a gate here — see §20.10.2.
absence: A missing lock file is a deleted guard, not ONLINE_OPEN. The contract test fails closed on it.
